Package com.avpkit.core.io

Class Helper

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.avpkit.core.io.Helper
  • public class Helper
extends java.lang.Object
    For Internal Use Only. This class only exists to help tests in other packages run the FFMPEG IO functions.

    Normal classes don't have access to these mechanisms, but we expose them here.
